# Project Context (LLM-optimized)

## Directives
- GRAPH-FIRST: explore code via `specd graph`; grep/glob only non-code or last resort. Stale/missing graph → `specd graph index`.
- `specs/` = requirements SoT; never edit directly. Workflow: draft → implement → review → approve → merge → archive. No code without spec; read/update existing specs; avoid duplicates.
- Artifacts, code, comments, docs English. Full spec: `specd specs context <id>`; include globals with `default:*`.
- TypeScript pnpm ESM monorepo. Hexagonal+DDD: domain no I/O; application ports; infrastructure adapters; rich entities enforce invariants; pure stateless services; manual DI.

## Global Specs — load full via `specd specs context <id>`

### default:_global/architecture
- Business packages: domain → application → infrastructure; inner layers never import outer. Domain no I/O; application uses ports; infrastructure excludes composition.
- Entities own invariants/typed transition errors; value objects expose behavior; stateless domain services are exported functions.
- Ports abstract classes with explicit methods. Constructor DI; no IoC/singletons. Validate external YAML at infrastructure boundary; typed `SpecdError`.
- Composition alone imports infrastructure. `createKernel`, `createKernelBuilder`, capability factories share resolver; canonical `createX(deps)`. Public barrels exclude concrete adapters.
- Adapter packages contain no business logic. Dependencies: plugin-* → skills → core; cli/mcp → sdk; sdk → core|code-graph; schema-* standalone; no cycles. Cross core/graph hosts use `@specd/sdk`.

### default:_global/conventions
- Strict TypeScript; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, ESM NodeNext. Named exports; kebab-case; explicit public returns; no `any`; expected errors use `SpecdError`; immutable domain.

### default:_global/testing
- Vitest; test tree mirrors src; `.spec.ts`; Given/When/Then; no snapshots. Domain/application unit tests mock I/O. Integration uses unique `os.tmpdir()` dirs and cleanup. Ensure cross-platform paths, fixtures, line endings.

### default:_global/docs
- Docs only under `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}`; exceptions: root README, AGENTS, CLAUDE.
- `docs/guide`: title/description/sidebar_position frontmatter; user usage only; configuration/workflows match core; begin with What is SpecD; cover skills, project update, plugins, graph. Keep SDK/package internals outside guide.
- ADR: sequential `NNNN-kebab-case`, MADR, Decision Outcome Confirmation + More Information/Spec; link source specs only.
- Every CLI command needs docs/cli page, index, sidebar; MCP schemas/examples in docs/mcp. Public symbols need full JSDoc.
- Hosts document/import `@specd/sdk` only. SDK collections under `docs/sdk/{core,code-graph,skills,schemas}` require frontmatter. Update affected docs for public composition, template/config cascades, list-contract changes.

### default:_global/eslint
- Type-aware TypeScript: forbid any/default exports; require explicit returns, kebab-case, JSDoc, layer boundaries. Lint before commit.

### default:_global/continuous-integration
- CI on macOS/Ubuntu/Windows for PR+main; pnpm 10.6.5, Node 22, frozen install; build → typecheck → test.

### default:_global/error-handling-conventions
- Expected user failures: `SpecdError`, `specd=true`, UPPER_SNAKE code, actionable message, JSON/TOON metadata.

### default:_global/logging
- Console-compatible `log/info/debug/warn/error`; info for normal events; fatal/trace through error/debug prefixes; abstraction over raw console.

findings.title: adaptersWithoutPackageResolution not reported; facet-absent counted as failure
findings.reason: Spec requires importDiagnostics.adaptersWithoutPackageResolution listing adapters lacking the facet, never counted in total/byReason/samples. ImportDiagnosticSummary has no such field and the indexer records one facet-absent diagnostic per adapter through recordImportDiagnostic, inflating total, byReason and samples.

evidence.detail: lines 934-942 facet-absent recorded as diagnostic; 1931-1936 summary lacks field
test at line 396 asserts a diagnostic names the missing facet

findings.title: adaptersWithoutPackageResolution not reported; facet-absent counted as failure
findings.reason: importDiagnostics summary omits adaptersWithoutPackageResolution and facet-absent entries are counted in total/byReason/samples, contrary to the modified requirement.

findings.title: Package identity step lacks failure isolation and first-adapter-wins
findings.reason: Spec: identity failure is recorded as an indexing error, adapter treated as not providing facet for that workspace, run continues; first adapter returning identity wins and later adapters are not asked. Code calls packageResolution.identity for every adapter and workspace without try/catch, and does not stop after the first adapter that returned an identity (a second adapter could register another package name for the same workspace).

findings.title: No tests for identity failure, collision error, first-adapter-wins, adaptersWithoutPackageResolution
findings.reason: No test asserts identity throw isolation, the two-workspace collision error, first-adapter-wins, or the adaptersWithoutPackageResolution list; only prepare-throw is tested.

findings.title: Incremental closure for newly added workspace or manifest change not asserted end to end
findings.reason: Incremental tests cover entry, barrel and importer changes; none asserts a previously unresolved import resolving when its target workspace is newly added, or an identity-altering manifest edit re-resolving importers (manifest change tested only at fingerprint/full-rebuild level).

evidence.detail: manifest change asserts full rebuild only

findings.title: No test for facet/capability separation
findings.reason: No test asserts capability flags and facets are independent declarations (hierarchy true without packageResolution, or reExportLinking not implying hierarchy).

findings.title: Provenance path and same-name no-guess only partly asserted
findings.reason: Language-independence test asserts resolved target and a non-existent name stays unresolved, but not the ordered path (local binding, import:package, public binding, target) nor the case where a unique same-name symbol exists in the package workspace.

findings.title: No test deletes composer.json before resolveToPath
findings.reason: Existing PHP tests write composer.json and read it back; none asserts no filesystem access after preparation.

findings.title: adaptersWithoutPackageResolution not provided; facet-absent counted in total
findings.reason: Run result has no importDiagnostics.adaptersWithoutPackageResolution; absent-facet adapters are recorded as a facet-absent diagnostic that is counted in total/byReason/samples, contradicting the scenario and design.md line 105.

evidence.detail: line 105 says facet-absent never counted in total

findings.recommendation: Add adaptersWithoutPackageResolution to summary, exclude facet-absent adapter notices from total/byReason, update test and docs

findings.title: identity() throw aborts the whole indexing run
findings.reason: The packageToWorkspace loop calls facet.identity with no try/catch (outer try has only finally), so a throwing identity rejects the run instead of recording an error, disabling the facet and indexing other adapters/workspaces.
findings.recommendation: Wrap identity in try/catch, push error and add adapter to disabledPackageResolution

findings.title: No tests for identity or link throwing
findings.reason: Only a prepare-throws test exists; identity and link failure isolation are unasserted (identity actually fails).

evidence.detail: line 425 is the only facet-throw test

findings.title: No test for per-file facet throw isolation
findings.reason: No test makes matchSpecifier/entrySurface/resolve throw for one file and checks other files still index.

findings.title: No type-level test that loose adapter methods are gone
findings.reason: No expectTypeOf/ts-expect-error assertion that LanguageAdapter lacks getPackageIdentity, resolvePackageFromSpecifier, etc., nor a TS facet-shape assertion.

evidence.detail: no matching assertion found by search

findings.title: No test that Go omits relative and qualified-name facets
findings.reason: No assertion that GoLanguageAdapter.relativeImportResolution and qualifiedNameResolution are undefined.

findings.title: No test that Go omits qualified-name facet
findings.reason: Same gap as relative facet omission.

findings.title: No test separating hierarchy capability from absent packageResolution
findings.reason: No test combines capabilities().hierarchy true with no packageResolution and checks both outcomes.

findings.title: No I/O-free assertion for entrySurface and matchSpecifier
findings.reason: No-fs assertions cover resolveImports/buildRelations only; entrySurface and matchSpecifier repeat-call purity is not asserted.

findings.title: matchSpecifier purity unasserted
findings.reason: Same gap.

findings.title: Missing facet counted as import failure; adaptersWithoutPackageResolution absent
findings.reason: Spec requires listing adapters lacking packageResolution in importDiagnostics.adaptersWithoutPackageResolution and never counting them in total. Indexer records facet-absent via recordImportDiagnostic, which increments total/byReason and samples; ImportDiagnosticSummary has no adaptersWithoutPackageResolution field.

evidence.detail: lines 934-942 record facet-absent via recordImportDiagnostic; total sums counts at ~1931
line 425 test asserts byReason facet-absent >= 1, contradicting the spec

findings.recommendation: Add the field and exclude facet-absent from total/byReason, or amend the spec if counting is intended

findings.title: Throwing identity() aborts the run instead of disabling the facet
findings.reason: Spec: a throw inside identity is recorded as an indexing error and the adapter is treated as lacking the facet for the rest of the run. The identity loop calls adapter.packageResolution.identity without try/catch and never adds the adapter to disabledPackageResolution, so the exception propagates out of execute. Only prepare and link are guarded.

evidence.detail: lines 1196-1211 prepare is guarded, for contrast

findings.recommendation: Wrap identity in try/catch, push an error, add adapter to disabledPackageResolution

findings.title: No test for throwing identity() or reExportLinking.link()
findings.reason: Only a throwing packageResolution.prepare is tested for facet error isolation; identity and link failures are untested.

findings.title: resolveToPath keeps legacy repoRoot signature and reads the filesystem
findings.reason: Spec: resolveToPath(qualifiedName, codeRoot, session) uses only session-prepared metadata and MUST NOT read the filesystem. Facet interface and PHP facet take (qualifiedName, codeRoot, repoRoot?), and buildPsr4Map re-reads composer.json on every call. resolveQualifiedNameFromSession exists but is not exposed through the facet. tasks.md 23.8 is unchecked.

evidence.detail: lines 493 and 2322-2331 resolveQualifiedNameToPath uses buildPsr4Map (file I/O)

findings.recommendation: Complete task 23.8: take session, delegate to resolveQualifiedNameFromSession, update tests and docs

findings.title: Adapter guide diverges from spec rules
findings.reason: Spec requires the page to state the same rules. Page documents resolveToPath(..., repoRoot?) rather than session; says entrySurface may return test files when explicitly addressed (spec: MUST NOT); checklist steps 6 and 7 differ (spec: pass cross-language conformance suite and facet scenarios; add to built-in adapter specs list).

evidence.detail: resolveToPath row, entrySurface rules, checklist steps 6-7
Adding a language adapter steps 6-7; Package resolution facet

findings.recommendation: Align page and spec after deciding which is authoritative

findings.title: resolveToPath keeps legacy repoRoot signature and reads the filesystem
findings.reason: Import specifier resolution requires Pass 2 qualified-name metadata to come from prepared session state; facet resolveToPath still rebuilds PSR-4 map from composer.json per call.

evidence.detail: lines 493 and 2322-2331 resolveQualifiedNameToPath uses buildPsr4Map (file I/O)

findings.title: Throwing identity() aborts the run instead of disabling the facet
findings.reason: Package identity is obtained through packageResolution.identity in an unguarded loop; a throwing adapter aborts indexing rather than being treated as lacking the facet.

findings.title: PHP resolveToPath reads composer.json on every call
findings.reason: resolveToPath rebuilds the PSR-4 map from disk per call and takes no session, so it cannot use prepared metadata; deleting composer.json after prepare breaks it, contradicting the facet I/O constraint and the scenario.

evidence.detail: resolveQualifiedNameToPath (~2322) calls buildPsr4Map -> findManifestField (readFileSync) each call
QualifiedNameResolutionFacet.resolveToPath(qualifiedName, codeRoot, repoRoot) has no session parameter

findings.recommendation: Read prepared psr4ByCodeRoot from the session (add session arg or per-codeRoot cache populated in prepare) or decide the delta wording

findings.title: PHP resolveToPath reads composer.json on every call
findings.reason: resolveToPath rebuilds the PSR-4 map from disk per call and takes no session, so it cannot use prepared metadata; deleting composer.json after prepare breaks it, contradicting the facet I/O constraint and the scenario.

evidence.detail: resolveQualifiedNameToPath (~2322) calls buildPsr4Map -> findManifestField (readFileSync) each call
QualifiedNameResolutionFacet.resolveToPath(qualifiedName, codeRoot, repoRoot) has no session parameter

findings.recommendation: Read prepared psr4ByCodeRoot from the session (add session arg or per-codeRoot cache populated in prepare) or decide the delta wording

findings.title: PHP resolveToPath reads composer.json on every call
findings.reason: resolveToPath rebuilds the PSR-4 map from disk per call and takes no session, so it cannot use prepared metadata; deleting composer.json after prepare breaks it, contradicting the facet I/O constraint and the scenario.

evidence.detail: resolveQualifiedNameToPath (~2322) calls buildPsr4Map -> findManifestField (readFileSync) each call
QualifiedNameResolutionFacet.resolveToPath(qualifiedName, codeRoot, repoRoot) has no session parameter

findings.recommendation: Read prepared psr4ByCodeRoot from the session (add session arg or per-codeRoot cache populated in prepare) or decide the delta wording

findings.title: main used although exports is defined
findings.reason: Spec says main is used only when exports is absent and a defined exports without '.' yields no candidates. publishedTargets falls back to manifest.main for subpath '.' whenever exports yields no runtime/types target, so exports without '.' (or with only unsupported conditions) still resolves via main.

evidence.detail: publishedTargets pushes manifest.main when exports gave no target
scenario main is ignored when exports is defined
no test for exports without '.' plus main

findings.recommendation: Fall back to main only when manifest.exports is undefined; add scenario test

findings.title: Default/namespace package import not asserted
findings.reason: No test asserts that a default package import binds the single default declaration, or that a namespace package import depends on entry files and creates a namespace binding.

findings.title: Submodule import dependency untested
findings.reason: No test asserts that 'from pkg import models' (not published by __init__) adds a file dependency on models.py with no binding.

findings.title: Python init-resolve and unknown-project scenarios untested
findings.reason: No Python test asserts a name published by __init__.py resolves, nor that an unknown absolute import yields package-unknown with nothing persisted, nor the name-found-elsewhere case.

evidence.detail: Python case covers only models import and re-imported alias

findings.title: Python entrySurface no-filesystem-read untested
findings.reason: No test deletes pyproject.toml after identity and asserts entrySurface still resolves, unlike the TypeScript equivalent.

findings.title: Go package-unknown reason not asserted at adapter level
findings.reason: The unknown-module test asserts only empty fileImports, not the package-unknown diagnostic reason.

findings.title: Fallback targets unindexed PSR-4 file
findings.reason: When the shared helper is unresolved, resolveImports falls back to resolveQualifiedNameFromSession, which returns the single PSR-4 candidate without checking it is indexed and pushes that absolute path into fileImports, after a diagnostic was already emitted.

findings.title: Cross-workspace longest-prefix untested
findings.reason: Longest prefix is tested only within one workspace map (resolveQualifiedNameToPath), not across workspaces via matchSpecifier.

findings.title: No test that prepare receives unchanged workspaces
findings.reason: No test asserts that packageResolution.prepare receives every workspace in an incremental run where only one workspace changed.

evidence.detail: only asserts call order and one prepare call

findings.title: Package identity collision error untested
findings.reason: No test builds two workspaces with the same package identity and asserts an error naming both workspaces.

findings.title: Constraints replacement drops two constraints silently
findings.reason: The delta replaces the whole Constraints section. Six constraints are removed; four are restated in requirement text, but the specs() callback exclusive/no filesystem fallback and the Pass 2 depends on Pass 1 for ALL workspaces constraints have no replacement as constraints. Confirm the removal is intended or restore them.
findings.recommendation: Restore the two dropped constraints or document the removal

findings.title: Throwing identity aborts the run
findings.reason: packageResolution.identity is called without try/catch in the package-map loop, so a throwing identity propagates and stops the run instead of being recorded as an indexing error.

findings.title: Identity not first-adapter-wins
findings.reason: The package-map loop asks every adapter with the facet for every workspace and never stops after the first non-undefined identity, so a second adapter is still asked and may add another mapping.

findings.title: Absent facet counted as failure; no adaptersWithoutPackageResolution
findings.reason: IndexResult.importDiagnostics has no adaptersWithoutPackageResolution, and the run records facet-absent through recordImportDiagnostic so it is counted in total, byReason and samples. The spec forbids counting it.

findings.title: Throwing identity untested
findings.reason: No test covers an adapter whose identity throws.

findings.title: Identity first-wins untested
findings.reason: No test registers two adapters answering for one workspace.

findings.title: Newly added workspace incremental package import untested
findings.reason: Incremental tests cover relative-import additions and entry/barrel/importer changes, not a package import that becomes resolvable when its target workspace is added.

findings.title: Closure not-scanning-every-file untested
findings.reason: No test asserts importers of a changed entry are found from persisted steps without re-reading unrelated files.

findings.title: resolveToPath reads composer.json from disk
findings.reason: qualifiedNameResolution.resolveToPath takes (qualifiedName, codeRoot, repoRoot) and rebuilds the PSR-4 map from the filesystem; spec requires reading the session-prepared map with no filesystem fallback.
